title: Tanner Camp

[[File:Tanner Camp.jpg|thumb|Tanner Camp]]

'''Tanner Camp''' is a small [[camp]] in the [[Searing Gorge]] where [[Sarah Tanner]], the master elemental [[leatherworker]] for the [[Alliance]], lives. Behind her tent is a long, sprawling passageway that leads to the [[thunder lizard]] [[Margol the Rager]].
